title: NRES the network of robotic echelle spectrographs
what_was_studied: Four-unit robotic architecture, deployment and commissioning performance
numerical_result: The production system was described at resolving power about 53000 over roughly 390 to 860 nm; early multi-site pipeline precision was about 75 m/s
remaining_question: Which unit-specific environmental and acquisition terms dominate repeatability?

title: Automatic echelle spectrograph wavelength calibration
what_was_studied: Automated two-dimensional wavelength solutions demonstrated on all four NRES units
numerical_result: The method was applied across four NRES spectrographs and HARPS rather than tuned to one detector only
remaining_question: How does calibration residual structure propagate into unit-to-unit velocity offsets?

title: The Network of Robotic Echelle Spectrographs
what_was_studied: BANZAI-NRES products, four-site operations and ongoing precision work
numerical_result: The poster reports current precision near 20 m/s for a V about 5.5 example and retains 3 m/s as a goal
remaining_question: What is the precision distribution by unit, magnitude, spectral type and epoch?

title: NRES instrument description
what_was_studied: Physical unit count, sites, spectral range and present performance framing
numerical_result: LCO lists four units at CTIO, SAAO, McDonald and Wise, R about 53000, 380 to 860 nm, accuracy about 10 m/s and a 3 m/s goal
remaining_question: Network-level wording must not erase different unit histories and status

title: Call for proposals 2026B and observatory status
what_was_studied: End of offered operations and unit-specific status
numerical_result: LCO states that NRES is no longer offered in 2026B; the status page separately records the Wise unit as decommissioned from 1 August 2026
remaining_question: Not offered is not automatically equivalent to physical decommissioning for the other three units
